# Financial Account

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:FinancialAccount`](gmeow-FinancialAccount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/FinancialAccount>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

A financial account held by an agent with a financial institution — a bank account, credit card, investment account, or wallet. Distinct from [`OnlineAccount`](gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) (social profiles, decentralized identity): this is the financial-existence layer. The account's legal terms are modelled as an [`Agreement`](gmeow-Agreement.md) between the holder and the institution.
